2105-3603-4460-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-3603-4460-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-3603-4460-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Cloudshift from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Cloudshift from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

265-2073-5330--90.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the Servo.
When the Servo dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
265-2073-5330--90.notes: If the artifact can sacrifice itself, you can do so in lieu of sacrificing the artifact to Atog. Also, if the artifact can tap to produce mana (like Sol Ring) or other products, you can do that as well.

1957-4050-7492--173.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature castable for {0}, adding {B}.
When that creature dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
When you gain life, Veinwitch Coven triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return the sacrificed creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast that creature by paying {0}.
Repeat.

728-3240-5631-6462.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and a creature token
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

3028-5702-7824.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
3028-5702-7824.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Nissa, Vital Force
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

413-1580-4871-6255.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Zahur and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

670-1619-3991-6136.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3991-6136.description:
Cast Faceless Butcher by paying its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
When Faceless Butcher dies, it triggers, returning Avenging Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Faceless Butcher from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Faceless Butcher trigger, exiling Avenging Hunter.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Faceless Butcher.
Repeat from step 5.

1368-4742-6321-6723.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-4742-6321-6723.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

789-3967-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-3967-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.
789-3967-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1232-1270-5477-7296.description:
Activate Nemata's first ability by paying {2}{G}, creating three 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate the Saprolings by tapping them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2872-4785-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

232-1235-4477-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Greenwarden of Murasa tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

512-4188-4241.notablePrerequisites: You have gained at least 2 life this turn.
512-4188-4241.description:
Activate Karn by paying {1}, causing Halo Fountain to become a creature.
Activate Accomplished Alchemist by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}.
Activate Halo Fountain's second ability by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and then untapping it and Accomplished Alchemist, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
512-4188-4241.notes: With the excess mana, you can use it on Halo Fountain's first ability, tapping and untapping it to create creature tokens.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4053-5231-6972.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
4053-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another nontoken creature without a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

628-2829-3108.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability
Repeat.
628-2829-3108.notes: You can remove the additional -1/-1 counters from Grim Poppet and put them on other creatures as desired.

1921-3464-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Hyrax Tower Scout from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Hyrax Tower Scout token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Hyrax Tower Scout token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

955-1350-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
955-1350-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1323-4687-5614.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Bighorner Rancher's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

781-1055-6498.description:
Cast Traumatize by paying its mana cost, causing an opponent to mill half their library, rounded down.
Activate Consuming Aberration by tapping it, causing the opponent to mill cards equal to the cards in opponents' graveyards, milling the remainder of their library.
781-1055-6498.notes: The opponent will mill the remainder of their library unless each opponent's graveyard was empty when the combo started and the opponent had an odd deck size.

2793-3743-4444-5089-6441.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4444-5089-6441.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2178-4660-5676.easyPrerequisites: Thornbite Staff attached to Bloodshot Cyclops.
1270-2178-4660-5676.notablePrerequisites: Bloodshot Cyclops does not have summoning sickness.
1270-2178-4660-5676.description:
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing Reef Worm.
When Reef Worm dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Reef Worm trigger, creating three 3/3 Fish creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Fish.
When the Fish dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Fish trigger, creating three 6/6 Whale creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 6, dealing damage equal to the FIsh's power to any target.
Repeat from step 6 for each other Fish token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Whale.
When the Whale dies, it and Bloodshot Cyclops trigger.
Resolve the Whale trigger, creating three 9/9 Kraken creature tokens.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 12, dealing damage equal to the Whale's power to any target.
Repeat from step 12 for each other Whale token.
Activate Bloodshot Cyclops by tapping it and sacrificing a Kraken.
When the Kraken dies, Bloodshot Cyclops triggers, untapping Bloodshot Cyclops.
Resolve the Bloodshot Cyclops ability from step 18, dealing damage equal to the Kraken's power to any target.
Repeat from step 18 for each other Kraken token.

1558-3529-4231-4865.notablePrerequisites:
Vesuvan Shapeshifter is a copy of Academy Manufactor.
Hoard Robber does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by at least one opponent.
1558-3529-4231-4865.description:
Attack with Hoard Robber.
Hoard Robber triggers on combat damage to a player, creating three Treasure tokens, three Food tokens, and three Clue tokens.
Activate Time Sieve's ability by tapping Time Sieve and sacrificing five artifacts you control, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

2178-4102-4227.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4102-4227.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

3750-4700-5220-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other nontoken Dinosaurs.
An opponent cannot block Gishath.
3750-4700-5220-5231.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Gishath.
Gishath triggers, causing you to reveal the top seven cards of your library and put all Dinosaurs revealed this way onto the battlefield.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod's second ability five times by sacrificing five other nontoken Dinosaurs, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the Dinosaurs die, Mortuary triggers that many times, putting the Dinosaurs on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.

3259-3973-4050-4478.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four permanents of any color on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature you control except Rith.
Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-3973-4050-4478.description:
Deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Rith trigger, causing you to pay {2}{G} to create at least four 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Saproling token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and deal combat damage using Rith and the creature with Breath of Fury attached, triggering Rith and Breath of Fury.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar three times by sacrificing three Saprolings, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-2894.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
250-779-2894.description:
Attempt to draw a card, instead discarding Dakmor Salvage due to Chains of Mephistopheles, then causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand due to Dakmor Salvage's dredge ability.
The Gitrog Monster's third ability triggers, causing you to discard Dakmor Salvage due to Chains of Mephistopheles, then causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand due to Dakmor Salvage's dredge ability.
Repeat step 2.

465-1430-4284.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Clone to the battlefield as a copy of Mirror Image, thus making it a copy of Wormfang Drake.
When Clone enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Mirror Image.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Clone.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image to the battlefield as a copy of Wormfang Drake.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios // Journey to the Oracle

1401-1644-4543.easyPrerequisites: You control lands that tap to add at least {2}{G}{G}.
1401-1644-4543.description:
Activate all lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{G}.
Activate Trench Behemoth's first ability once for each land you control by returning them from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Trench Behemoth and giving it hexproof.
Cast Journey to the Oracle either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{G}{G} and commander tax, if applicable.
Resolve Journey to the Oracle, putting all land cards from your hand onto the battlefield, and then discarding a card to return Journey to the Oracle to your hand.
When the lands enter the battlefield, Trench Behomth and Tatyova trigger once for each of them.
Resolve the Tatyova triggers, causing you to draw that many cards and gain that much life.
Resolve the Trench Behemoth triggers, forcing up to that many creatures to attack in future if able.
Repeat.

1931-3615-4050-4999.description:
Cast Wild Dogs from your graveyard by paying {G}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wild Dogs, adding {G}.
Wild Dogs is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Humility removing Wild Dogs's cycling ability.
Repeat.

372-2517-5276.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-2517-5276.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, exiling Leonin Relic-Warder until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Leonin Relic-Warder leaves the battlefield, triggering its second ability, returning Parallax Wave from exile to the battlefield.
Activate Parallax Wave by removing a fade counter from it, exiling Abdel Adiran.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from exile to the battlefield.
Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, triggering its first ability, exiling Parallax Wave.
Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, returning Abdel Adrian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1171-1235-3129-3908.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, targeting Spark Double as copy of Garth One-Eye, creating two token copy of Spark Double as a copy of Garth One-Eye.
Activate first Garth One-Eye token by tapping it, choosing Black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate Black Lotus by tapping and sacrifing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate second Garth One-Eye token by tapping it, choosing Regrowth.
Cast the copy of Regrowth targeting Twinflame, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Twinflame by paying its strive cost, targeting two token copy of Spark Double as a copy of Garth One-Eye, creating four token copy of Spark Double as a copy of Garth One-Eye.
Activate the first three Garth One-Eye token by tapping it, choosing black Lotus.
Cast the copy of Black Lotus.
Activate two Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate third Black Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate the fourth Garth One-Eye token by tapping it, choosing Regrowth.
Cast the copy of Regrowth targeting Twinflame, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.

83-2034-3490.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
83-2034-3490.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {C}{C}.
Mortician Beetle triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

404-1521-2105-3480.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
404-1521-2105-3480.description:
Declare Flamerush Rider, Combat Celebrant and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant, Ghired's second ability and Flamerush Rider trigger.
Resolve the Flamerush Rider trigger, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Ghired trigger, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Resolve the Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Move to your next combat phase, and declare the Combat Celebrant token created in step 4 and Ghired as attackers, choosing to exert the Combat Celebrant token as it attacks.
Repeat from step 4.
Optionally, you may also attack with Flamerush Rider to get infinite copies of any other attacking creatures you control.

721-2724-3314.notablePrerequisites: Chulane does not have summoning sickness.
721-2724-3314.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Chulane by paying {3} and tapping them, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1295-3244-4211.description:
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it, exiling your graveyard.
Cast Morality Shift by paying {5}{B}{B}, exchanging your graveyard and library.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

2497-3617-5261.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying {1}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2}, casting a copy of Reclaim without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the Reclaim, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

2665-3617-4125.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
2665-3617-4125.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Shipwreck Dowser.
When the token Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2882-4563-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-4563-4675-4694.description:
Cast Everflowing Chalice by paying {0}.
Everflowing Chalice enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Everflowing Chalice from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3469-4241-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-4241-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-4241-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Karn.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat from step 2.
